description: Ticketmaster Discovery API — search live events by keyword, city, countryCode, stateCode, venueId, attractionId, classificationName (e.g. 'Music'), and date window. PREFER for "what is on at <venue>", "upcoming <artist> concerts", "events in <city> this month". Pass the venue/artist as keyword, or venueId from venue_search for an exact venue. Returns events with dates, venue, and ticket links.

keyword.description: Free-text search: venue, artist, team or event name (e.g. "Madison Square Garden", "Taylor Swift"). Pass the subject of the question here — omitting it returns Ticketmaster's unfiltered default feed, not an answer.

page.description: 0-based page number. Ticketmaster caps deep paging at page × size ≤ 1000, so with the default size of 20 the last reachable page is 50; narrow with city/date filters instead of paging further.

sort.description: Sort order. Ticketmaster accepts only these values; anything else is a 400. Common: "date,asc" (soonest first), "relevance,desc".

startDateTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z". Use with endDateTime for "this month".

venueId.description: Ticketmaster venue id (from venue_search). More precise than keyword for "what is on at <venue>" — a keyword can match a nearby or similarly named venue.

name: event_search

outputSchema.description: Raw JSON response from Ticketmaster event search API

title: Event Search
